In detail

North Tallinn: Kalamaja's wooden houses and the Telliskivi creative quarter at one end — now one of the city's most visited areas — and the old Kopli industrial peninsula at the other. The two ends are not alike, and the district appears alongside Lasnamäe in municipal youth crime-prevention work. Nothing in the reporting suggests trouble for visitors around Telliskivi or Balti jaam; the caution is for the far end of the peninsula late at night.

Is Põhja-Tallinn safe?

Wandroz currently rates Põhja-Tallinn in Tallinn as an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Tallinn at night. Is Põhja-Tallinn safe at night?

At night, Põhja-Tallinn is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Tallinn. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
